faq.a1: Session Sniffer ekolera bweru 100% — esoma pakiti z'omukutu mu kasirise ng'eyita mu ddereeva z'okukwata eza bulijjo (Npcap / libpcap / BPF) era tefuyirira oba okukyusa fayiro oba omujjukizo gw'omuzannyo n'akatono. Tewali mutawaana gwonna ogw'okugobwa anti-cheat, era koodi yonna ey'ensibuko esobola okukeberwa olukale ku GitHub wansi wa GPLv3.
faq.a2_help: Osanze ekizibu oba olina ekibuuzo? Loopa ebisobu ku GitHub Issues oba buuza ekibiina ku seerva yaffe eya Discord.
faq.a2_s1: Wanula Session_Sniffer.exe empya eya Windows (oba fayiro ya Linux / macOS okuva mu kitundu ky'okuwanula waggulu).
faq.a2_s3: Bw'osabibwa ku Windows, teekako Npcap — yeetaagisa okukwata obupaketi bw'omukutu. Ku Linux, teekako libpcap era owe olukusa lw'okukwata (cap_net_raw); ku macOS, wa olukusa lw'okusoma /dev/bpf* nga bwe kiragiddwa mu ndagiriro y'okuteekako.
faq.a2_s4: Londa ekigatta omukutu ky'oyagala okuketta olyoke onyige Tandika Okuketta.
faq.a3_s1_eth: Kebo ya Ethernet: Yungako kebo ya Ethernet wakati wa kompyuta yo n'ekyuma ky'emizannyo ogabane yintaneeti ya kompyuta (laba vidiyo ennyonnyola wansi).
faq.a3_s1_title: Gabana yintaneeti ya kompyuta yo n'ekyuma ky'emizannyo
faq.a3_s1_wifi: Wi-Fi Hotspot: Kozesa ekintu ekiri munda mu Session Sniffer ekiyitibwa Hotspot n'Okugabana Omukutu (Okukwata → Hotspot & Okugabana) oba "Mobile hotspot" mu ntegeka za Windows okugabana yintaneeti awatali waya.
faq.a3_s2_desc: Ggyako PlayStation oba Xbox yo ku mukutu gwa yintaneeti kw'eri kati, olyoke ogiyunge ku Wi-Fi hotspot oba Ethernet gy'ogabanye okuva ku kompyuta yo.
faq.a3_s2_title: Yunga ekyuma ky'emizannyo ku mukutu ogugabanyiziddwa
faq.a3_s3_desc: Ggulawo Session Sniffer, mu ddirisa lya Okulonda Ekigatta Omukutu gw'Okukwata noonyako olunyiriri oluliko Muliraanwa mu mpagi ya Ekika. Kebera empagi ya Erinnya ly'Omugabi (Microsoft Corporation ku Xbox oba Sony Interactive Entertainment Inc. ku PlayStation) — oba geraageranya Endagiriro ya IP n'Endagiriro ya MAC n'entegeka z'omukutu ku kyuma kyo — olyoke onyige Tandika Okuketta.
faq.a3_s3_title: Ggulawo Session Sniffer olonde ekigatta kya Muliraanwa
faq.a5: Yee — ya bwereere 100% era ya open source wansi wa layisinsi ya GNU GPLv3, nga tewali bisale, okusasula buli mwezi, oba okukung'aanya ebiwandiiko byo (telemetry). Bw'onyumirwa okugikozesa n'oyagala okuwagira enkulaakulana egenda mu maaso, osobola okusalawo okugabira ku Ko-fi.
faq.a_antivirus_1: Yee — Session Sniffer terina bulabe bwonna okugikozesa. Pulogulaamu ezimu eziziyiza obuwuka ziraba fayiro ezitambula zokka ng'obuwuka kubanga zikoleddwa okuva mu Python nga bakozesa PyInstaller, ekintu ekitera okuleeta okulabula okw'obulimba ne ku pulogulaamu ezitalina mutawaana.
faq.a_antivirus_2: Koodi yonna eri mu lwatu era efumbikiddwa ku GitHub. Bw'oba omanyi Python, oyinza n'okutambuza Session Sniffer butereevu okuva mu koodi yayo, ekitera okwewala okulabula kw'obuwuka.
faq.a_antivirus_3: Okwongera ku ekyo, fayiro ezafulumizibwa zizimbibwa zokka okuyita mu GitHub Actions era ne ziteekebwayo botti ya GitHub Actions, bw'otyo oyinza okwekenneenya enkola y'okuzimba n'ebyafaayo byayo byonna mu lwatu.
faq.a_arp_s1_desc: Ku lukalala lw'ebikozesebwa, genda ku Okukwata → Kyusa Ekigatta Omukutu — oba ggulawo Entegeka → Ebya Bulijjo, gyako Okwegatta Kwokka, olyoke oddemu otandike Session Sniffer.
faq.a_arp_s1_title: Ggulawo olutimbe lwa Okulonda Ekigatta Omukutu gw'Okukwata
faq.a_arp_s2_desc: Teeka akabonero ku Teekako ARP Spoofing mu nsonda eya wansi ku ddyo ey'eddirisa.
faq.a_arp_s3_desc: Nyiga ku Zza Obuggya Emmeeza ya ARP mu nsonda eya wansi ku kkono ey'eddirisa. Kino kizuukusa ebyuma ku mukutu gwo ogwa waka, Session Sniffer esobole okuzuula PlayStation, Xbox, essimu n'ebyuma ebirala.
faq.a_arp_s4_desc: Londa PlayStation, Xbox, essimu oba ekyuma ekirala ky'oyagala okukebera, olyoke onyige Tandika Okuketta.
faq.a_filesize_1: Session Sniffer egatta Python n'ebigenderako byonna ebyetaagisa mu fayiro emu etambula yokka, pulogulaamu esobole okukola amangu ago nga tewetaaga kussaawo kintu kyonna na mikono.
faq.a_filesize_2: Ekibinja kino kirimu ebitabo by'okukebera obupaketi, olutimbe lwa PySide6, enkwata ya data, ennyambala, envvuunula n'ebirala — eyo ye nsonga enkulu lwaki fayiro eno nnene katono.

faq.q2: Nteeka ntya era ntegeka ntya Session Sniffer?

faq.q_arp: Nketta ntya nga nkozesa ARP Spoofing (PlayStation, Xbox, essimu…)?

features.f1_desc: Ekola ku mutendera gwa pakiti gwokka ng'eyita mu Npcap, libpcap, oba macOS BPF. Tewali kuyingira mu mujjukizo, tewali mod zeetaagisa, era tewali bulabe bw'okugobwa mu muzannyo.
features.f1_title: Ya Bweru 100% era Nnywevu ku Kugobwa
features.f2_desc: Siba okukwata ku pulogulaamu y'omuzannyo gwa PC emu, oba kebera PlayStation, Xbox, n'ebyuma ebitambulwa nabyo ng'oyita mu kugabana Ethernet, Hotspot ya Wi-Fi erimu, oba LAN ARP.
features.f3_desc: Ekweka kyokka ssaava za Rockstar, ez'ekire, eza relay, n'ez'omuzannyo abazannyi abatuufu bokka balabike — ng'ogasseeko enkalala za IP eziziyizibwa, ebisengejja bya ISP, n'ebisengejja by'amateeka g'omukutu.
features.f4_desc: Lamba mikwano gyo oba abalabe mu materekero ga UserIP n'amannya, langi, n'obubaka by'otegeka. Funa obubaka obwangu ku lutimbe, okulabula kw'eddoboozi lya TTS, n'amateeka g'okuzuula agakola gokka.
features.f5_desc: Okuzuula Omutegeka w'Olutuula ne relay mubuliwo, Ebyafaayo by'Omukyaza, Olutuula lw'Olukale Omu Yekka ku lunyiga lumu, Ekizuula Omuzannyi mu muzannyo, n'okunoonya mu kire kwa Looky System.
features.f5_title: Ebikozesebwa eby'Amaanyi ebya GTA V ne RDR2
features.f6_desc: Kebera ebipande by'entambula ya PPS/BPS mubuliwo, ebifaananyi by'okulwawo kw'okukwata, ebipande by'obungi bwa pooti, ensengeka y'obudde bw'olutuula, era ofune okulabula okwangu ku kulinnya kw'entambula ennyingi.
features.f6_title: Ebifaananyi Mubuliwo n'Omukuumi wa Sipidi Ennyingi
features.lead: Yazimbibwa mu Python ne PySide6 ng'eyungiddwa butereevu ku libpcap/Npcap — erina emisinde egimala entuula ezijjudde abazannyi 30 nga tekwata ku mujjukizo gw'omuzannyo.
features.title: Buli Kye Weetaaga Okulondooleza Entambula ya P2P
footer.disclaimer: Obubonero bw'ebyobusuubuzi n'ebifaananyi by'emizannyo byonna bya bannannyini byo. Tekikwatagana na mufulumya yenna awandiikiddwa.
footer.note: Omulondoozi w'entuula za P2P ow'obwereere era owa open-source okuva eri IB_U_Z_Z_A_R_Dl · Wansi wa layisinsi ya GNU GPLv3. Tewali birango, tewali cookie ziketta, tewali telemetry.

history.era1_caption: PS3 Blacklist Sniffer v2.1.1 — Windows CMD ne TShark (Jan 2022)
history.era1_h1: Okuzuula mubuliwo amannya g'abakozesa ga PSN butereevu okuva mu ntambula ya netiwaaka y'omuzannyo
history.era1_h2: Ebitegeeza ku lutimbe lwa Windows ne webMAN MOD ku PS3 ezimenyeeko ekkomo
history.era1_h3: Enkyusa 25 mu myezi 6 (commit 94) ezaazimba omusingi gw'okulondooleza P2P
history.era1_summary: Session Sniffer we yatandikira: yatondebwa okusooka ng’okwekuuma ku bazannyi abakola obulumbaganyi bwa DDoS, IP booters, n’abakozesa mod menus okugwisa omuzannyo ku PlayStation 3 mu GTA V, GTA IV, Red Dead Redemption, Minecraft, ne Call of Duty. Ssikuliputi eno eya Windows Batch yakozesanga TShark okulondoola entambula ya netiwaaka mu kiseera ekyo ng’enoonya amannya ga PSN agali ku lukalala oluziyizibwa, n’ewa obubaka bwa mangu ku Windows ne webMAN MOD PS3 osobole okuvaayo nga tebannagwisa muzannyo gwo oba okukuggyako.
history.era2_caption: GTA V Session Sniffer v1.0.0 — Omulembe Ogusooka ogwa Python TUI (Jan 10, 2023)
history.era2_h1: Yinjini esooka eya Python TUI enzijuvu eraga bonna abali mu lutuula abagattiddwa n'abavuddeko
history.era2_h2: Okuzuula ensi okwasooka okwa MaxMind GeoLite2 n'okulondooleza pooti za buli ali mu lutuula
history.era2_h3: Yakolanga ku PC, Xbox One, ne PlayStation awatali kukyusa fayiro z'omuzannyo
history.era2_summary: Okuddamu okuwandiika okwasooka mu Python kuno kwafulumizibwa nga 10 Janwaliyo 2023 awamu ne PC Blacklist Sniffer olw'obuyambi bwa mukwano gwange omwatiikirivu {grub4k}, eyanjigiriza Python n'ekisa mu budde bwaffe obw'eddembe ne nsobola okuva ku bulwawo n'obuzibu bwa Batch ne ngenda ku lulimi olwanguwa ennyo. Oluvannyuma lw'okuba n'akawandiiko akaalabulangako ku mannya g'abakozesa ne IP ezimu zokka ze nsisinkana mu muzannyo, nnayagala okulaga olutuula lwonna mu bisenge byange ebya GTA V — olw'okuba kyandibadde kirungi, olw'okulondoola n'okwagala okumanya, n'okumalako obudde nga ndi AFK mu muzannyo nga nkola koodi. GTA V Session Sniffer v1.0 yalondoolanga buli ali mu lutuula agattiddwa n'avuddeko mubuliwo n'obudde bwa Yasooka/Yalabiddwa Lusembayo, ebibala paketi, pooti, n'okunoonya ensi kwa MaxMind GeoLite2 — awatali mod za muzannyo.

history.era3_caption: GTA V Session Sniffer v1.1.8 — PrettyTable TUI n'Engule y'Omutegeka (Nov 6, 2024)
history.era3_h1: Ekizza obuggya MaxMind GeoLite2 kyokka n'okugaggawaza kwa IP-API okw'omugatte kwa IP 1,500 buli dakiika
history.era3_h2: Okusikana LAN ARP, obubonero bw'Essimu / VPN / Obupangisa bwa Seva n'engule y'Omutegeka w'Olutuula
history.era3_h3: Emmeeza za PrettyTable TUI ezisengekebwa, ebipimo by'Emirundi gy'Okudda / PPS ne Discord Rich Presence
history.era3_summary: Omwaka 2024 gwe gwali ekiseera lwe nnayagala ennyo okukola ku pulojekiti eno n'okugirongoosa — okugiwandiikira koodi kwafuuka kusanyusa ddala era nga kunyumira nnyo okugizimba. Amaanyi ago gaakyusa ekiwandiiko ne kifuuka ekifo ekituufu eky'okwekebejja amawulire: okuwanula amaterekero ga GeoLite2 kyokka, okusikana LAN ARP, okunoonya kwa IP-API okw'omugatte kwa IP 1,500 buli dakiika, endabika za PrettyTable ezirina langi ez'abagattiddwa n'abavuddeko, ebipimo by'Emirundi gy'Okudda ne PPS, okuzuula Essimu/VPN/Obupangisa bwa Seva, okulondooleza engule y'Omutegeka w'Olutuula, ne Discord Rich Presence byonna byatuuka.

history.era4_caption: Session Sniffer v1.3.0 — Ekiyungiro kya Kompyuta Ekisooka ekya PyQt6 (Des 2024 / Jan 2025)
history.era4_h1: Ekiyungiro kya PyQt6 + QDarkStyle ekya ddala ekisooka nga kirina emmeeza ezisengekebwa ne menyuu z'okunyiga ddyo
history.era4_h2: Yakyusibwa erinnya okufuuka "Session Sniffer" ey'awamu ne fayiro za Windows .exe ezidduka zokka
history.era4_h3: ICMP/TCP Ping, emmeeza ezizingibwa, ebipimo by'Obunene bw'Entambula, obulabuzi bwa TTS n'ebiwandiiko bya Rich
history.era4_summary: Okujja kwa AI kwe kwandeetera amangu okusalawo okuzimba ekifananyi ky'emirimu (GUI) mu Python — era sitya kukyogerako. Okusigala mu Python kyali kyangu: koodi yonna n'enkola ey'emabega byali biwedde era nga bikola bulungi nnyo, kyokka nali neetaaga ekifananyi eky'okungulu. Nga 15 Desemba 2024, ekikozesebwa ky'ebigambo kyakula ne kifuuka pulogulaamu ya kompyuta eya PyQt6, ate nga 4 Janwaliyo 2025 pulojekiti yaleka "GTA V" okufuuka Session Sniffer ey'awamu — n'eyongerako fayiro za .exe ezidduka zokka, menyuu z'okunyiga ddyo, Ping ya ICMP/TCP n'eya kweyita, okunoonya abakola ba MAC mu Wireshark, emmeeza ezizingibwa, ebipimo by'obunene bw'entambula, obulabuzi bw'eddoboozi lya TTS, n'okweyita kwa ARP (ARP spoofing).

history.era5_h3: Endabika 6 ezirimu + Omuddukanya w'Endabika ow'ebika bya langi 20 n'ennimi 33 ezirina ensengeka ya RTL enzijuvu
history.era5_summary: Enkyukakyuka esinga obunene mu byafaayo bya pulojekiti eno — era ekyazimbiddwa n'essanyu mu Python. Ne bwe wabeerawo AI, saayagala kuzimba sniffer mu lulimi lulala lwe simanyi: mmanyi Python kale mwandiika mu Python, ngaana okubeera muzibe ku koodi AI gy'ekola, era njagala okufuga buli kantu kakyuseko — bw'etyo enkola ya koodi ey'omulembe guno bw'eri, wakiri eri nze. Yazimbibwa buto ng'ekibinja kya PySide6 ekirina okukwata paketi okwa ddala kwa libpcap/Npcap/BPF (nga tekyetaaga TShark) ku Windows, Linux, ne macOS, n'eyongerako ebikozesebwa bya RDR2, Looky System, Ebifaananyi Mubuliwo, Ebizuuliddwa n'Amateeka g'Omugatte, Olubaawo lw'Omukutu ku LAN olulimu ne QR Code, Omuddukanya wa Hotspot ya Wi-Fi, endabika 6 + Omuddukanya w'Endabika, n'ennimi 33 ezirina RTL.

history.title: Ebyafaayo Ebijjuvu bya Session Sniffer
history.v_1_0_0: Omulembe ogusooka ogwa Python TUI owa GTA V Session Sniffer ogulondooleza abali mu lutuula abagattiddwa n'abavuddeko, obudde bwa Yasooka/Yalabiddwa Lusembayo, ebibala paketi, pooti, n'okunoonya ensi.
history.v_1_0_4: Yazza obuggya amaterekero ga Python ag'abantu abalala era n'ereeta enkola y'ekisomi kya MaxMind GeoLite2 mu v1.0.4 – v1.0.6.
history.v_1_1_0: Yayongerako okuwanula n'okuzza obuggya amaterekero ga MaxMind GeoLite2 kyokka, okusikana LAN ARP, n'okusengeka ebitundu okw'enjawulo awamu n'ebipima obudde bya PPS.
history.v_1_1_6: Yayongerako kolamu z'okuzuula Essimu, VPN/Proxy, n'Obupangisa bwa Seva, ekibala Emirundi gy'Okudda, okunoonya kwa IP-API okw'omugatte kwa IP 1,500 buli dakiika, n'okuzuula engule y'Omutegeka w'Olutuula (v1.1.6 – v1.1.9).
history.v_1_2_0: Yalongoosa emmeeza za PrettyTable TUI, yayongerako Discord Rich Presence, era n'egaziya okukwatagana okukakasiddwa ku PC, PS3, PS5, ne Xbox One (v1.2.0 – v1.2.9).
history.v_1_3_0: Okuddamu okuwandiika okukulu mu kiyungiro kya kompyuta ekya PyQt6 + QDarkStyle n'okukyusa erinnya mu butongole okufuuka "Session Sniffer", nga kyongerako menyuu z'okunyiga ddyo, langi za UserIP, n'okulonda/okukoppa obusenge obungi.
history.v_1_3_3: Yafulumya fayiro za PyInstaller .exe ezidduka zokka nga zirina TShark/Npcap munda, ebikolwa bya Ping ya ICMP/TCP n'eya kweyita, kolamu ya Pinging, n'okuzuula reverse-DNS okwanguyiziddwa (v1.3.3 – v1.3.6).
history.v_1_3_7: Yatandika okukozesa ennamba z'enkyusa ez'obudde bw'okuzimba bwa UTC eza PEP 440, yalongoosa okuzuula ebiyungiro by'okukwata, era n'etereeza okusengejja broadcast/multicast (v1.3.7 – v1.3.7post6).
history.v_1_3_8: Yakyusa okunoonya omukola wa MAC okudda mu tterekero lya Wireshark manuf, yalongoosa okubala kwa PPS okw'awamu, era n'eyongerako ennyunga ez'amangu mu kabaawo k'ebikozesebwa (v1.3.8 – v1.3.8.post2).
history.v_1_3_9: Yaleeta okulabula kw'okuzuula mubuliwo eri emikutu gy'Essimu, VPN, n'Obupangisa bwa Seva awamu n'amapeesa g'okukyusa ebitegeeza mu kiyungiro.
history.v_1_4_0: Yayongerako emmeeza z'Abagattiddwa/Abavuddeko ezizingibwa nga zirina omuwendo gw'abazannyi mubuliwo, yalongoosa enkola y'emmeeza ezifunye, era n'enyweza enkwata ya IP y'Omutegeka w'Olutuula.
history.v_1_4_1: Okuddamu okusengeka okunene okwa koodi enkulu nga kugabanya enkola emu ey'okukwata paketi, okunoonya, n'okulaga mu bitundu ebiyonjo.
history.v_1_4_2: Yalongoosa okuzuula ensobi z'okweyita kwa ARP (ARP spoofing), okukakasa IP/pooti okugumu, okugatta ensobi awamu, n'okunyweza enkola y'obulamu bw'okukwata kwa TShark (v1.4.2 – v1.4.2.post5).
history.v_1_4_3: Yayongerako ebipimo by'Obunene bw'Entambula, kolamu za paketi ezisobola okukwekebwa, enkola ya langi ey'ekiyungiro egabanyiziddwamu ebitundu, ebitegeeza eby'eddoboozi lya TTS ebya Jane/Liam, n'okuwandiika ebibaddewo okusengekeddwa okwa Rich (v1.4.3 – v1.4.3.post4).
history.v_1_5_0: Commit 2,100+ n'enkyusa z'okugezesa 115: ekibinja kya src/ ekigabanyiziddwamu ebitundu, ekiyungiro kya PySide6, okukwata paketi okwa ddala okwa libpcap/Npcap/BPF (tewali TShark), fayiro za Windows/Linux/macOS, ebikozesebwa bya RDR2, Looky System, Ebifaananyi Mubuliwo, Amateeka g'Omugatte, Olubaawo lw'Omukutu ku LAN + QR Code, Omuddukanya wa Hotspot, Ekinoonyereza Pooti, Endabika 6 + Omuddukanya w'Endabika, n'ennimi 33 ezirina RTL.
history.v_pc: Ekiwandiiko ekikolagana nakyo ekya Windows PC ekizuula IP eziri ku lukalala oluziyizibwa mu GTA V ne Minecraft Bedrock Edition nga kikozesa TShark/Npcap ne Settings.ini esobola okukyusibwa.
history.v_ps3: Ssikuliputi eyasooka eya Windows Batch + TShark eyakolebwa okulabula ku balumbaganyi ba DDoS, IP booters, n’abagwisa omuzannyo ne mod menus ku PS3; okuzuula mubuliwo amannya ga PSN, Blacklist.ini, n’obubaka bwa Windows ne webMAN MOD mu mifulumya 25 (v1.0 → v2.2.4).
meta.description: Omulondoozi w'entuula za P2P mubuliwo ow'obwereere era owa open-source, ekigooberera abazannyi, n'ebikozesebwa by'okwekebejja omukutu ku PC, PlayStation, Xbox, n'essimu. Bya bweru 100% nga tewali mod zeetaagisa.
